Trained from scratch, Beam is designed for coding, reasoning, and AI agents. Reflection's benchmarks put it alongside the strongest open models, with substantially more efficient token economics. To mark Beam’s debut, I'm joined by Reflection's co-founders: CEO @MishaLaskin, who led reward modeling for Google’s Gemini, and CTO @real_ioannis, who helped create AlphaGo and AlphaZero before leading Gemini’s RLHF effort. rows.text: 🇺🇸 Peter Schiff sees something in this stock market that has only happened twice in the last century. In 1973 and again around the dot-com bubble, market gains became this concentrated in so few stocks. Both times, the S&P eventually fell close to 50%. “Every time you get to a situation that you know is extreme and has a history of ending in a disaster, everybody always says, ‘Yes, but this time it’s different.’” Schiff’s concern is that America is now making the same bet again, only this time the magic word is AI.
